# Ali Reza Habibi (ahabibidev)

> Official website of Ali Reza Habibi, known online as **ahabibidev** — a
> Full-Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience,
> specializing in frontend development with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

Ali Reza Habibi is currently a Software Engineer at FirstRate Inc (Texas, USA —
Kabul office). He holds a BSc in Software Engineering from Kabul University.
He builds digital experiences across web, mobile, and desktop.

**Contact:** contact@ahabibi.dev

## Projects

- [Hesabi Finance App](https://ahabibi.dev/projects/hesabi-finance-app): Personal income, expense, and budget tracker. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, SQLite.
- [Qimat — Real Time Prices](https://ahabibi.dev/projects/qimat-real-time-prices): PWA tracking live prices for essentials, phones, currencies, and fuel. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Drizzle.
- [Portfolio Website](https://ahabibi.dev/projects/portfolio-website): This site. Next.js App Router, structured data, strict CSP.
- [Hospital Management System](https://ahabibi.dev/projects/hospital-management-system): Patients, appointments, staff, and billing. PHP, Bootstrap, Chart.js.
- [MOWJ Technologies](https://ahabibi.dev/projects/mowj-technologies): Digital agency website. WordPress, Elementor, PHP, MySQL.
